description: List sales invoices. Paginated, with server-side filters (date range, status, payment status, customer) applied by the API. Brief view by default; use view='full' or get_sale_invoice for detail.

date_from.description: Only invoices with revenue date on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD). Server-side filter.

date_to.description: Only invoices with revenue date on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD). Server-side filter.

modified_since.description: Return only objects modified since this timestamp (ISO 8601)

payment_status.description: Filter by payment status (server-side): PAID, PARTIALLY_PAID, or NOT_PAID. Unpaid invoices read back with payment_status "" or null, not NOT_PAID.

status.description: Filter by status (server-side): PROJECT (draft) or CONFIRMED.

view.description: Response detail: brief (default) returns triage fields; full returns every API field.

name: list_sale_invoices
title: List Sale Invoices
